_comment: Schema for data/pulse-quality-report.json — the Phase 2 quality gate report. It is assembled by the runner's --gate step and combines THREE independent layers: (1) the deterministic reconciler (scripts/lib/verify-claims.js — numbers, polarity, narrative, advice scan, freshness; pure code, no AI); (2) the independent AI validation agent (role 'validation', a DIFFERENT provider than editorial, e.g. gemini_3_1_pro) graded on grade/cohesion/honesty; (3) schema + the existing test suites. The final verdict is computed deterministically: RED if any hard check fails or confidence < min_confidence_for_yellow; YELLOW if confidence in [yellow,green) or a soft reconciler warning; GREEN only if everything is clean AND confidence >= green_threshold. Nothing auto-publishes unless verdict == GREEN AND auto_publish_enabled AND kill-switch on.

reconciler._comment: Deterministic checks from verify-claims.js. pass=true means no hard reconciliation failure. Pure code; never an AI judgement.

numbers_ok._comment: every prose number reconciles to real data or the allowlist

polarity_ok._comment: every drafted status word agrees with computed data direction via editorial_polarity

narrative_ok._comment: Weekly Connection narrative direction does not contradict aggregate signal directions

freshness_ok._comment: editorial dates are today and recompute leaves review_required false for edited items

validation_agent._comment: Independent AI checker (different provider than the drafter). It scores meaning-level quality the deterministic layer cannot. Its confidence feeds the verdict but can NEVER override a reconciler hard failure (a RED stays RED no matter how confident the validator is).

confidence._comment: overall confidence the draft is accurate, clear, and honest

reading_grade._comment: estimated US grade level of the drafted prose

honest_no_overclaim._comment: draft does not claim more than the findings + data support

structural._comment: Schema + test-suite + diff-guard results on the post-apply tree (computed deterministically).

editorial_only_diff._comment: true = applying the draft moved ONLY editable prose paths; false = a read-only data path would change (hard RED)

tests_pass._comment: all 5 existing scripts/test/* suites + data-validate recompute pass on the applied tree

blocking_reasons._comment: Human-readable list of every reason the verdict is not GREEN. Empty on GREEN.

auto_publish._comment: What the gate decided to DO. published true only when verdict GREEN AND auto_publish_enabled AND kill-switch on AND not shadow_mode.
